profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
In developing meaningful software experiences, I’ve combined my creative and meticulous nature to feed my goal-driven spirit and love for problem solving. I have a background in Marketing and Graphic Design, where I learned core skills and a mentality, which now has a heavy influence when I design and build thoughtful web applications. I’m seeking a web development position ideally at a company who is committed to supplying a quality product, where I can grow as a developer.
Check out my work at kat-morris.com

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: ECommerce Designer | Front End Web Developer
Web Development Immersive | Engineering Fellow
positions.description: General Assembly’s Web Development Immersive (WDI) is a 12 week training program in Full-Stack Web Development dedicated to prepare students to think like engineers and approach problems creatively in order to build the next generation of web applications and digital products. Worked with HTML & CSS, Javascript, React, Node JS, Express, Ruby amongst other tools and platforms.

positions.title: Marketing Associate
positions.description:
Managed social media accounts including Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and Google+. Created the company Instagram account. Photographed and edited images for social media posts and wrote content. Identified and reported success metrics internally.

Published marketing materials including company newsletters and magazines, and sales presentation materials. Designed and edited ads for various local newspapers, magazines, and mailings.  

Represented Brandywine and the company owner and CEO at charity planning meetings, networking events, board meetings, and career fairs.

Organized and planned events for industry conferences like the MIX Group a trade organization, the Chester County Economic Development Council, as well as fundraising events for the Fame Fire Company Capital Campaign, Chester County Hospital Challenge for Cancer, March of Dimes, and The West Chester Downtown Foundation’s annual event Up on the Roof.

positions.title: Bank Teller
positions.description:
Examined checks and matched bank accounts while cashing checks for customers.
Verified identification, account numbers, signatures, dates, written amounts, and numerical amounts.
Created and distributed certified treasures checks and money orders.
Handled large amounts of cash in the upwards of $25,000 while keeping a balanced drawer.

volunteerExperiences.role: Executive Leadership Team Member, March for Babies West Chester
volunteerExperiences.description:
Event planning and logistics on the Executive Leadership Team for the March of Dimes charity walk, March for Babies in West Chester.

Supervised the registration booth, trained volunteers on the registration procedures, ensured the registrations process was as quick and smooth as possible, and properly handled any payments and donations.

Supervised and helped break down and clean up after the event until the job was complete, and the park looked untouched.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: FAME FIRE COMPANY NO 3 OF WEST CHESTER PA
volunteerExperiences.description: Helped plan, market, set up, and break down events for benefit a fire company expansion.
